countries.reasoning: South Africa is the primary producer of iridium due to its extensive platinum group metal (PGM) mining industry, with USGS data from 2023 confirming its dominance with reliable statistics.

Russia produces significant amounts of iridium as a byproduct of its nickel mining operations, with government and industry reports from 2022-2023 supporting this figure, though some data has limited transparency.
Known for its PGM deposits, Zimbabwe contributes notably to iridium production; data from mining reports and estimates from 2022 have some gaps, leading to moderate confidence.
Canada produces iridium as a byproduct of its nickel and PGM mining sectors, with reasonable but less comprehensive data available from 2022.
The US has minor iridium production from PGM mining, with estimates from USGS and industry sources; data is less detailed, thus lower confidence.
